If you choose recorded voice, we’ll send your voice to ElevenLabs to turn your words into text. ElevenLabs hears what you say before our system can remove names. We’ll record the conversation to document your report. Our system uses a protected version of the text to draft a case. An authorised human case handler reviews it and decides what happens next. You can report without giving your name. Your voice, connection details or the events you describe could still identify you. Access to the report is restricted. In some circumstances the law can require information to be shared. You can use secure text instead, or ask to speak to a person without recording. The privacy notice on this page explains who handles the information, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights. To use ElevenLabs voice processing and agree to the recording, choose “Start recorded voice”. For text, choose “Report by text”. For an unrecorded conversation, choose “Speak to a person”.
